entry_points.notes: Every governed row, record, head, map and the retry key are written inside the one outermost transaction (LED-B4.14 holds on the journal). Non-transactional journal entries are $Increment counters and id counters only: ^KG("__version"), ^KG("gen",g,s) (degree generation), ^NKG("$meta",...) and ^NKG(-3,..) (incremental snapshot counters, module 04/10 code reached through rdf_edges' functional index), row-id counters ^t52S.*.1 and rdf_props index 7 ("W",n) nodes; none is a governed row. They are not undone when a commit rolls back (cf. module 08's F-C0801 for ^NKG).
